row.notes: Two callers. 0x1434be460 (call 0x1434be69e; the state 10/11 hold-in-garage alignment, called from Game_PitLane_UpdateMovement at 0x1434b9199 for state 10 and 0x1434b92c6 for state 11) passes the pit lane record +0xe0 as box unchecked. Game_Pitlane_ApplyVehicleResetState 0x1434c03c0 (call 0x1434c0493, case 4 of jump table 0x145845cc8) passes [entry+0xe0] after a signed <= 0x17 check, so 99 stops there and -1 passes. Reads the cached spline handle at mgr+0x7f8+box*8 (0x1434c3656) and stores it there on a miss (0x1434c36a6), with no bound on box. Game_PitLane_GenerateSplines 0x1434ca550 zeroes 24 slots (0x7f8..0x8b7); tuning handles follow from +0x8b8 and the per-car records start at mgr+0x938. -1 (a third car in a garage has no box) faults at 0x1434c3656 (mov r8,[rbx+r14*8+0x7f8], mgr+0x8000007f0). 99 reads mgr+0xb10 inside the per-car records: a non-null qword there goes to 0x1434c5c90 as a hint, and a null one is overwritten at 0x1434c36a6. Returns false (cmp edi,2 at 0x1434c4202, setne al at 0x1434c4205) when 0x1434c5c90 returns 2, with out untouched; 0x1434be460 then leaves the car alone and 0x1434c03c0 takes its error path (0x1434c04a0). focus325 and simon_92216 1.6.12 crashes. Needs L2 promotion by the game owner.
